kurz: The operating mode defines where this installation may connect to. It is enforced at every point where the AMW reaches outwards – not just in the interface.
brauchst: The AMW runs on this PC.
An answer to the question: may data of this project leave the machine or the company network?

schritte.text: Settings › Operating mode. Below it you find the list “Connections of the AMW”: every address the AMW connects to and where it leads (this PC only, company network, internet). As a command: `amw einrichten verbindungen`.
Click one of the three cards and save. As a command: `amw einrichten betriebsart pc` (or `server`, `cloud`).
Press “Test connections”. Every allowed address is tested for reachability (connection only, no data). Red marks what is switched on but blocked in this mode.
Fix red rows: switch the service off (e.g. sync off, notifications off) or choose another mode.

werte: Nothing leaves the machine: no sync, no online page, no notifications
Own server on the company network
Connections only to addresses on your own network (e.g. `192.168.…`, `10.…`, names like `ntfy.company.lan`)
Online storage, online page and notification services on the internet are allowed
fehler: “Betriebsart …: Verbindung zum Online-Speicher zu … ist blockiert”
The chosen mode does not allow this address. Change the mode or switch the sync off.
In “This PC only”, and for internet services also in “Own server”, they are not sent; the delivery log states the reason.
A name on the company network counts as internet
A name with a dot only counts as company network if it points exclusively to addresses on your own network. Otherwise enter the address as a number.
danach: Nothing chosen yet? Then what ran so far applies: with sync or notifications switched on “Cloud”, otherwise “This PC only”.
The operating mode applies to this PC and all projects on it.
fragen: Does really nothing leave the machine in “This PC only”?
The AMW itself then opens no outbound connection. What runs outside the AMW is not covered: Claude Code talks to its provider, Git to its server.
Can I use ntfy in “Own server”?
Yes, with your own ntfy server on the company network – there also via `http://`. The public service `ntfy.sh` is on the internet and is then blocked.
Online storage and online page on my own network?

Yes: your own libSQL server as storage and the online page on a company web server. `amw web paket --seite https://amw.company.lan --speicher https://amw-db.company.lan` builds a ZIP on the PC with everything the web server needs, including instructions, and enters the access on this PC. On the company network `http://` works too – the sign-in page and the settings then warn, because passwords travel unencrypted.
What happens to the “Open in Claude” button?
It leads to the internet and is only shown in the “Cloud” mode.
Can I open the Workbench from a phone or tablet on my Wi-Fi?

Yes. Under Settings › This PC › “Reachable from the home network”, enter the address range of your Wi-Fi, for example 192.168.178.0/24 on a Fritzbox, and restart the service. Then open http://<address of this PC>:8780 on the phone, such as http://192.168.178.20:8780. **Every device in this network then has full rights without signing in** – as at the PC. Only private networks are allowed; the Workbench refuses requests from other addresses. A guest network (192.168.179.x on a Fritzbox) is outside the range and stays out. While it is on, the control panel shows it under “Computer”. Windows asks about the firewall the first time; otherwise create an inbound rule for port 8780 yourself, for the “Private” profile only – AMW changes nothing in Windows. Leaving it empty switches it off again.
